local_web.use: Received-coordinate English literary evidence only; no translation, textual, historical, theological, or boundary authority.

review_method.proposal_scope: Every split, merge, or unresolved seam repair proposed by the literary primary was replayed against the local WEB Daniel witness.
review_method.larger_unit_rule: When a seam remains unresolved, retain the larger coherent child and mandatory macro parent rather than force consensus.
review_method.macro_parent_rule: All exposed children remain hydrated within their complete court-tale, dream-interpretation, vision-interpretation, prayer-response, or Dan.10.1-Dan.12.13 final-revelation parent.

seam_reviews.support: Dan.1.8-16 has its own resolve, permission negotiation, ten-day test, observed result, and steward action. Dan.1.17 changes subject with the four youths, introduces their enablement, and proceeds to the appointed examination and court standing.
seam_reviews.counterevidence: The dietary test and later examination jointly complete the youths' court formation, and Dan.1.17-21 should not be presented as an unrelated success story.

exact_remedy.rejected_alternative: Retain Dan.1.8-Dan.1.21 as one undifferentiated child.

seam_reviews.support: Dan.2.14-16 is a court intervention that obtains time from the king. Dan.2.17 changes location to Daniel's house, expands the participant group to his companions, and begins the petition-revelation-praise movement.
seam_reviews.counterevidence: The household petition depends on the time gained in court, so the two short scenes should never lose their shared dream-crisis context.

exact_remedy.rejected_alternative: Retain Dan.2.14-Dan.2.23 as one scene despite the court-to-house reset.

seam_reviews.support: The furnace sequence reaches public inspection at Dan.3.27: the gathered officials verify that the fire had no effect. Dan.3.28 then begins Nebuchadnezzar's blessing, decree, and promotion coda in a new proclamation form.
seam_reviews.counterevidence: The proclamation interprets the rescue and completes the court tale's reversal, so exposing it as a child cannot detach it from the ordeal.

exact_remedy.rejected_alternative: Retain Dan.3.19-Dan.3.30 as a single child that obscures the ordeal-to-decree form change.

seam_reviews.support: Dan.4.28-33 narrates fulfillment, delay, boast, interruption, and abasement. Dan.4.34 opens after the stated period with resumed first-person testimony, restored understanding, praise, restored rule, and the proclamation's closing confession.
seam_reviews.counterevidence: Restoration is the intended reversal of abasement, so the children remain mutually interpreting movements of the complete royal proclamation.

exact_remedy.rejected_alternative: Retain Dan.4.28-Dan.4.37 as one child despite the narrated abasement-to-first-person-restoration reset.

seam_reviews.support: The inscription interpretation closes at Dan.5.28. Dan.5.29 begins enacted court response, followed by the same-night death and transfer notice, forming a compact investiture-and-reversal coda.
seam_reviews.counterevidence: The coda verifies the interpretation and the received-coordinate transition near Dan.5.31-Dan.6.1 is versification-sensitive; no witness or ruler identity may be selected.

exact_remedy.rejected_alternative: Retain Dan.5.17-Dan.5.31 as one child or move the received-coordinate boundary by witness preference.

seam_reviews.support: Release and reversal against the accusers finish at Dan.6.24. Dan.6.25 explicitly begins a universal royal letter whose decree, hymnic rationale, and tenure notice form the tale's proclamation coda.
seam_reviews.counterevidence: The decree exists because of the den deliverance and therefore cannot be retrieved as free-standing royal theology or detached from the violence and court trap that precede it.

exact_remedy.rejected_alternative: Retain Dan.6.16-Dan.6.28 as one child that hides the ordeal-to-letter form transition.

seam_reviews.support: Dan.8.27 reports Daniel's sickness, recovery, return to court work, and continued incomprehension as the narrated effect of the commissioned interpretation. The one-verse coda is too dependent on the messenger encounter to stand as a useful child.
seam_reviews.counterevidence: The sealing command closes direct speech at Dan.8.26 and Dan.8.27 changes back to first-person aftermath, but this form change is an internal coda rather than a sufficient independent retrieval unit.

exact_remedy.rejected_alternative: Retain Dan.8.27-Dan.8.27 as a standalone aftermath fragment.

seam_reviews.support: Dan.10.1-3 supplies the dated message superscription and completed three-week mourning preparation. Dan.10.4 introduces a new day and river location, followed by the apparition, companion flight, weakness, hearing, and collapse.
seam_reviews.counterevidence: The mourning prepares for the encounter and its duration is recalled in the messenger dialogue, so both children require the continuous final-revelation parent.

exact_remedy.rejected_alternative: Retain Dan.10.1-Dan.10.9 as one child despite the explicit day-and-location reset.

seam_reviews.support: Dan.11.2-4 is a compact succession prologue ending in fourfold breakup and transfer beyond the ruler's posterity. Dan.11.5 introduces the sustained north-south conflict register with a fresh directional subject.
seam_reviews.counterevidence: The prologue supplies conditions for the conflicts and the same messenger speaks continuously; the seam is a discourse movement, not an identity or historical reconstruction.

exact_remedy.rejected_alternative: Retain Dan.11.2-Dan.11.20 as one undifferentiated succession-and-conflict child.

seam_reviews.support: Dan.11.35 closes a wise-ordeal movement with refinement, the time of the end, and the appointed time. Dan.11.36 begins a fresh self-exaltation portrait before another explicit end-time campaign threshold at Dan.11.40.
seam_reviews.counterevidence: There is no speaker or scene reset, and literary evidence alone cannot decide whether 'the king' continues, recasts, or changes the preceding subject. Treating identity as settled would contaminate the seam rationale.

exact_remedy.specific_hold_question: Can Dan.11.35|Dan.11.36 be defended solely as a discourse-movement seam while refusing every same-ruler versus new-ruler inference?
exact_remedy.rejected_alternative: Accept Dan.11.35|Dan.11.36 by identifying the ruler or force a false consensus.

seam_reviews.support: Dan.12.1 twice marks events as occurring 'at that time,' directly continuing the preceding campaign's end into crisis, deliverance, awakening, wise vindication, and the sealing charge through Dan.12.4. The chapter boundary does not outweigh that forward linkage.
seam_reviews.counterevidence: Dan.12.1 changes the immediate actor and subject matter, and Dan.12.4's direct address and sealing command close a recognizable culmination movement. Those features justify an internal submovement, but not a separate top-level child under the larger-unit rule.

exact_remedy.rejected_alternative: Retain separate Dan.11.36-Dan.11.45 and Dan.12.1-Dan.12.4 children merely because Dan.12.1 begins a new chapter and culmination submovement.

seam_reviews.dissent: The literary primary retained Dan.12.1-Dan.12.4 separately. This peer recommends the larger cross-chapter child and preserves the disagreement for boss and external/human review.

append_only_dissent_recommendations.question: Should the strong temporal continuation at Dan.11.45|Dan.12.1 produce one Dan.11.36-Dan.12.4 child, subject to the separate hold at Dan.11.35|Dan.11.36, rather than two children split at the chapter boundary?
append_only_dissent_recommendations.peer_position: Use Dan.11.36-Dan.12.4 if the 11:35|11:36 seam survives; otherwise use Dan.11.21-Dan.12.4. Keep Dan.10.1-Dan.12.13 as mandatory parent in either case.
append_only_dissent_recommendations.primary_position: Retain Dan.11.36-Dan.11.45 and Dan.12.1-Dan.12.4 as separate children while preserving the final-revelation parent.
append_only_dissent_recommendations.evidence_for_peer_position: Dan.12.1's doubled temporal linkage carries the preceding end directly into trouble, deliverance, awakening, wise vindication, and the closing seal command.
append_only_dissent_recommendations.counterevidence_for_primary_position: Dan.12.1 introduces a culmination movement and Dan.12.4 closes it with direct address, so a subordinate internal seam remains defensible.
